title: Five wins. Five late escapes.
summary: Cleveland’s 27–24 win over Tennessee extended an unusual start: each of its first five wins featured the winning score in the final four minutes of regulation or overtime.

timeline.label: Week 7
timeline.text: Cleveland beat Tennessee by three points.

timeline.label: After the game
timeline.text: NFL Communications highlighted the timing pattern across all five Cleveland wins.

timeline.label: Historical comparison
timeline.text: The published comparison identifies the 2016 Lions as the other team to do this since 1970.

unusual: It is a narrow, explicitly defined historical filter, not a claim that Cleveland always wins close games.
explanations: Close contests create late winning-score opportunities. A descriptive streak alone does not establish repeatable skill or a betting edge.
questions: The league comparison is cited as published; no independent play-by-play rebuild was performed.
